gate.threshold_selection_rule: Evaluate thresholds [5, 10, 20, 50, 100] on the two known-truth arms only, in ascending order; select the smallest threshold for which both arms satisfy all three fixed linearity criteria. Threshold 5 is the minimum because the diagnosed sparse-context tail is defined by counts below 5. No real-data value participates in selection.
gate.twin_definition: Count-level synthetic draws use the exact cached real prefix occupancy for the first two services and draw each outgoing bit count from Binomial(n_context, p) or Binomial(n_context, q).

estimator_sentence: For each prefix position i, estimate the symmetrized conditional Bernoulli KL contribution used by the reference d_chain_fast implementation, but condition both empirical context laws on the intersection of contexts with at least T observations under P and at least T observations under Q; renormalize each law over the retained transition mass, and use the reference add-0.5 conditional smoothing only on those retained contexts. T is fixed by the control-only threshold rule below and is never selected using real-data divergence values.

excluded_mass.definition: For each known-truth arm, mass excluded is the transition mass outside the shared context set with n_P >= T and n_Q >= T, aggregated over all positions and reported separately for P and Q.
